{{Otheruses|Xi}}
'''Xi group''' was a designator used for groups of [[Class-A cargo container|Class-A]]<ref name="X-wingOSG">''[[X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> and [[Class-B cargo container]]s by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and [[Class-E cargo container|Class-E]]<ref name="TF">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref> and [[Class-I cargo container]]s by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="TFDotE">''[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire]]''</ref>

The [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] of Xi group was part of an Imperial depot [[Mission to steal grain|investigated]] by Rebel [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] during a [[Operation Grain Snatch|Rebel operation]] to secure a [[Grain/Legends|grain]] supply after the [[evacuation of Yavin]], who found that group Xi did not contain grain.<ref name="X-wingOSG" />

Later, container group Xi formed part of a secret Imperial [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] research base developing [[Shield X|shielding technology]]. Xi group was destroyed by Farlander, flying an [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]], and a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] pilot.<ref name="X-wingOSG" />

Hidden in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]], Xi group, composed of Class-A cargo containers [[Xi 1 (Lonsigar)|''Xi 1'']] and [[Xi 2 (Lonsigar)|''2'']], were inspected by Farlander and had their [[Lonsigar|contents]] ferried to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Stimsenj'kat]]'' by [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] group [[Renhoek (transports)|Renhoek]] during an Imperial attack.<ref name="X-wingOSG" />

During the Galactic Empire's [[Battle for Honor|hunt]] for defector to the Rebel Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Class-E cargo container group Xi stored [[Water/Legends|water]] at a Rebel supply station [[Raid near DS 5|raided]] by the Imperial [[Mu Squadron]] of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wing]] pilots,<ref name="TF" /> [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] among them. In the crossfire between Imperial and Rebel forces, the cargo containers, including ''[[Xi 3]]'', were destroyed.<ref name="TFOSG">''[[TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>

Three Class-B cargo containers of Xi group, carrying two [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] prototypes each, were [[Attack on Research|brought]] to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for inspection by [[cargo ferry]] group [[Sela (cargo ferry group)|Sela]].<ref name="TF" />

In a [[Battle of Organarms|battle]] later [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulated]] for the training of Imperial [[Missile Boat]] pilots, Xi group Class-I cargo containers around Rebel [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] ''[[Organarms]]'' were destroyed by Missile Boat Mu 1.<ref name="TFDotE" />
